nota: Narração em inglês com voz masculina, no estilo do vídeo do HPM (Humana). Os títulos na tela ficam em português e servem de legenda pro público do Brasil. As cenas do app são gravadas no modo demonstração (demo/).

cenas.fala: Planning a trip with friends? The group chat turns into chaos.
With Tripwave, everyone swipes the places they want. When the crew agrees, it's a match.
Can't decide where to stay? Everyone votes, and nobody gets left out.
Paid for dinner? Just type it. Tripwave splits it and shows who owes who.
Every step you lock in earns a stamp on your crew's passport.
This is Tripwave. Grab your crew and go.
cenas.texto: Chama a galera e vai junto
